sources.title: Chinchunmei at SemEval-2025 Task 11: Boosting the Large Language Model ...
sources.snippet: The sample-based contrastive approach trains the model by comparing two samples to generate more reliable predictions. The generation-based contrastive approach trains the model to differentiate between correct and incorrect generations, refining its prediction. All models are fine-tuned from LLaMa3-Instruct-8B.
